audit.root_cause: SpecDecodeToolset lives in specdecode_rl/environment.py, which has no `if __name__ == "__main__": SpecDecodeToolset.run()` entrypoint. When verifiers serves the toolset in the runtime (`python -m specdecode_rl.environment`), the module just defines classes and exits, so the tool server never writes its port and every rollout ends with a ToolsetError.
audit.evidence: src/semih__specdecode-rl/specdecode_rl/environment.py has no `__main__`/`.run(` (grep: no matches); working V1 toolset envs all have one, e.g. primeintellect__forth-lang/forth_lang/toolset.py:157-158 `if __name__ == "__main__": ForthLangToolset.run()` (also wikispeedia, belief-feed, sika-agent). rollout.log: all 10 rollouts `stop=ToolsetError ... server did not report its port`. The runpy RuntimeWarning is only noise. [INFERENCE] docker/prime runtimes launch the server the same way, so this isn't caused by subprocess mode.
audit.irl_fix: Move SpecDecodeToolset into its own module ending in `if __name__ == "__main__": SpecDecodeToolset.run()`, the way the reference envs do.
